We apply the AM-GM inequality to each factor in the numerator:
\[x^2 + 3x + 1 \ge 3 \sqrt[3]{x^2 \cdot 3x \cdot 1} = 3 \sqrt[3]{3x^3} = 3x \sqrt[3]{3},\]
\[y^2 + 3y + 1 \ge 3 \sqrt[3]{y^2 \cdot 3y \cdot 1} = 3 \sqrt[3]{3y^3} = 3y \sqrt[3]{3},\]
\[z^2 + 3z + 1 \ge 3 \sqrt[3]{z^2 \cdot 3z \cdot 1} = 3 \sqrt[3]{3z^3} = 3z \sqrt[3]{3}.\]
Thus, the expression is at least
\[\frac{(3x \sqrt[3]{3})(3y \sqrt[3]{3})(3z \sqrt[3]{3})}{xyz} = 27 \sqrt[3]{3} = \boxed{24.5}.\]

By AM-GM,
\[x^2 + 1 \ge 2x,\]so
\[\frac{x^2 + 3x + 1}{x} \ge \frac{5x}{x} = 5.\]Likewise,
\[\frac{y^2 + 3y + 1}{y} \ge 5\]and
\[\frac{z^2 + 3z + 1}{z} \ge 5,\]so
\[\frac{(x^2 + 3x + 1)(y^2 + 3y + 1)(z^2 + 3z + 1)}{xyz} \ge 125.\]Equality occurs when $x = y = z = 1,$ so the minimum value is $\boxed{125}.$
